patches.title: Piecewise formula for absolute value
patches.rationale: The first case ends with a dangling conjunction, while the second case supplies no condition to complete it. Removing “and” restores the unmistakable standard piecewise definition without changing its mathematical scope.

patches.title: Three modular-congruence formats
patches.rationale: The surrounding paragraph explicitly presents modular relations, for which the congruence symbol is $\equiv$. The source's $\cong$ is inconsistent with that stated purpose.

patches.title: Comparison of delimiter-sizing commands
patches.rationale: The final parenthesis is a closing delimiter, so it requires the matching right-delimiter command $\bigr$ rather than the left-delimiter command $\bigl$.
